title: Forest-cultivated Epimedium koreanum Nakai mitigates organotin-induced renal injury and the exacerbation of diabetic nephropathy via the SIRT1/NRF2/PPARgamma signaling pathways.
authors: Hou, Jingang; Han, Lu; Liu, Siyu; Sun, Mengqi
one_liner_zh: 该文研究森林栽培淫羊藿通过SIRT1/NRF2/PPARgamma通路缓解有机锡诱导的肾损伤，属于纯药理学与代谢机制研究，无蛋白质-DNA互作、无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Organotin compounds, such as tributyltin (TBT) and triphenyltin (TPT), are persistent environmental pollutants; however, their role in exacerbating chronic kidney diseases remains poorly understood. This study identifies how organotins exploit metabolic vulnerabilities in diabetic nephropathy (DN) and demonstrates the superior protective efficacy of Epimedium koreanum Nakai cultivated in forest (EKF) over conventional varieties. METHODS: We integrated in silico modeling and network toxicology with in vitro validation using human renal proximal tubular epithelial cells. Cells derived from normal and diabetic conditions were exposed to organotins. Untargeted metabolomics identified bioactive constituents in EKF. Mechanistic validation was conducted using siRNA-mediated SIRT1 ablation and pharmacological inhibition (Ex-527) to define the regulatory role of the SIRT1/NRF2/PPARgamma axis. RESULTS: Network toxicology identified the SIRT1/NRF2/PPARgamma axis as a central node of organotin-induced renal damage. In vitro, a diabetic environment significantly exacerbated organotin-induced cytotoxicity (p < 0.05), characterized by a surge in reactive oxygen species and aberrant induction of the obesogenic marker PPARgamma. EKF provided superior protection against redox collapse and lipotoxicity compared to open-field varieties. Untargeted metabolomics identified Acetyl-l-carnitine (ALCAR) as a key bioactive constituent in EKF that restores SIRT1 expression. We demonstrate that EKF requires SIRT1 catalytic activity to re-activate the NRF2/HO-1/GSTP1 antioxidant defense while restricting pathological PPARgamma-mediated lipid peroxidation. Notably, silencing or inhibiting SIRT1 significantly abrogated the protective effects of EKF on downstream NRF2 and PPARgamma pathways. CONCLUSION: These findings establish the SIRT1/NRF2/PPARgamma axis as a mandatory mediator of renal resilience against organotin-exacerbated diabetic nephropathy. EKF mitigates injury by recruiting the SIRT1 metabolic sensor to restore renal equilibrium. EKF supplementation represents a strategic intervention to decouple environmental pollutant exposure from metabolic disease progression in high-risk populations.
abstract_zh: 背景：有机锡化合物，如三丁基锡（TBT）和三苯基锡（TPT），是持久性环境污染物；然而，它们在加剧慢性肾脏疾病中的作用仍知之甚少。本研究揭示了有机锡如何利用糖尿病肾病（DN）中的代谢脆弱性，并证明了林下栽培的朝鲜淫羊藿（Epimedium koreanum Nakai cultivated in forest, EKF）相较于常规品种具有更优的保护效力。方法：我们整合了计算机模拟建模和网络毒理学，并使用人肾近端小管上皮细胞进行体外验证。来源于正常和糖尿病条件下的细胞暴露于有机锡。非靶向代谢组学鉴定了EKF中的生物活性成分。通过siRNA介导的SIRT1敲除和药理学抑制（Ex-527）进行机制验证，以明确SIRT1/NRF2/PPARgamma轴的调控作用。结果：网络毒理学将SIRT1/NRF2/PPARgamma轴确定为有机锡诱导肾损伤的核心节点。体外实验中，糖尿病环境显著加剧了有机锡诱导的细胞毒性（p < 0.05），其特征为活性氧激增和致肥胖标志物PPARgamma的异常诱导。与露地品种相比，EKF在抵抗氧化还原崩溃和脂毒性方面提供了更优的保护。非靶向代谢组学鉴定出乙酰左卡尼汀（Acetyl-l-carnitine, ALCAR）为EKF中的关键生物活性成分，可恢复SIRT1表达。我们证明，EKF需要SIRT1催化活性来重新激活NRF2/HO-1/GSTP1抗氧化防御，同时限制病理性PPARgamma介导的脂质过氧化。值得注意的是，沉默或抑制SIRT1显著消除了EKF对下游NRF2和PPARgamma通路的保护作用。结论：这些发现确立了SIRT1/NRF2/PPARgamma轴作为肾脏抵抗有机锡加剧糖尿病肾病损伤的必需介质。EKF通过招募SIRT1代谢传感器恢复肾脏平衡来减轻损伤。EKF补充代表了一种战略性干预措施，可在高风险人群中切断环境污染物暴露与代谢疾病进展之间的关联。
